{{Top|leg}}
'''Paramedic droids''' were a type of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]]. [[TelBrinTel Corporation]] expanded their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] offerings during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by adding paramedic and [[information-collating droid]]s to their product line.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
